claim_scope: Complete classification over every field of characteristic two for the unperturbed nilpotent evolution chain of dimension n>=2; finite-field exact total and rank distribution.
scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof is included; computational samples independently tested exact finite instances. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No claim for arbitrary upper-triangular perturbations of the chain multiplication.
No claim in odd or zero characteristic, or for other operator weights.
Finite enumerations are verification cases, not proof for all fields.
Equivalent unindexed earlier literature remains possible.
title: Characteristic-two weight-one Rota–Baxter operators on chain evolution algebras
